lglc-methodology.text: How was this calculated? This estimate assumes 60 equal monthly payments at an unchanged nominal annual interest rate of 7.5%. Monthly interest rate = annual rate ÷ 12. Monthly repayment = P × r ÷ (1 − (1 + r)^−n), where P is the original loan amount, r the monthly interest rate and n the number of payments. Total interest = total repayments − amount borrowed. Fees and rate changes are excluded. This is an illustration, not a loan offer. The calculation uses a nominal annual borrowing rate, not a representative APR, and excludes fees and additional charges.
